title: HDF Runner Primitive
description: Information about the test execution environment where the security tool/scanner was executed.

name.description: The name of the operating system running the test tool. Example: 'ubuntu', 'macos', 'windows'.

release.description: The version/release of the operating system. Example: '20.04', '13.2', '11'.

architecture.description: The CPU architecture of the runner system. Example: 'x86_64', 'arm64', 'aarch64'.

hostname.description: The hostname of the runner system. Example: 'ci-runner-01', 'jenkins-agent-03'.

Runner.description: Information about the test execution environment. This is distinct from the target being scanned - the runner is where the security tool executes, while targets are what is being assessed.
Runner.title: Runner
